tone.target: dry 80s arena rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.profile: dry 80s arena rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A punchy, mid-focused signal chain utilizing a British amp model (UK 50) with moderate distortion and a tight cabinet to achieve an 80s arena rock sound.

rig.name: John Cougar Mellencamp - Hurt So Good - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise.
Provide light grit and boost the upper mids for bite.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a classic British overdrive/Plexi tone, matching the 'Marshall/Plexi style' clue.

blocks.purpose: Add hard, riffy crunch without sounding like heavy metal gain.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style provides a mid-focused, aggressive crunch suitable for 80s rock, avoiding the 'metal gain' and 'fuzz' warnings.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi sound and provide core tone.
Provide the required classic British cabinet sound.
Boost the upper mids and high end for 'bright bite' while keeping low end tight.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for precise mid-range sculpting to achieve the desired 'upper-mid bite'.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No wah needed for this dry crunch tone).
blocks.gap: The target sound is punchy and direct, making a dedicated Wah unnecessary.
The target sound is dry and punchy, so all mod effects are bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth without muddying the punchy core tone.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add dimension, keeping the focus on the dry crunch.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and ambience (matching 'small spring reverb' clue without being too wet).
blocks.gap: Room reverb is chosen over Spring/Plate to provide natural, non-metallic ambiance suitable for arena rock.
